items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: Yeah, same thing with Bichet. When Bichet got here and went up there he went to town.

ctx.x: But he growed more after he got up there?

Oh, after he went up there he just went on to town. Yeah, same thing with Bichet. When Bichet got here and went up there he went to town. When Bichet was here, he stood raggedy all his days. He'd come here with a suit full of clothes and in a little time he was raggedy. This was his bad luck place for him. He went on up the road, he done good the many they got. Kept himself naughty. Down here just like a man hanging up sleeping in some junk shop. Now when Sidney left here and Jimbo left, I was supposed to leave…
